name: Beach Village at The Del
positioning: Gated, private enclave of beachfront cottages and villas within the Hotel del Coronado, on Coronado Beach, with a personal concierge for every stay
best_for: Couples and families who want a beachfront cottage or villa with a full kitchen and fireplace
Larger groups needing two- or three-bedroom cottages and villas

facts.text: Beach Village at The Del is a private beachfront enclave of cottages and villas on the sands of Coronado Beach.
Beach Village is a private enclave within the Hotel del Coronado.
Beach Village is a gated community of beachfront cottages and villas.
Beach Village is part of LXR Hotels & Resorts.
A stay at Beach Village includes a personal concierge.
Beach Village guests may request personal shopping, party planning and VIP tours at local attractions.
Beach Village offers a private welcome experience.
Beach Village guests get priority reservations across the resort.
Guests can reserve Del Beach daybeds and half-moon cabanettes.
The Oval Pool has private cabanas and cabanettes, with the Breezes poolside bistro delivering coastal fare to your chair.
The Oceanview Villa Loft is a two-story villa with oceanview balconies, a full kitchen and an outdoor day tub.
The three-bedroom Beachfront Fireside Cottage has a beachfront terrace with three fire pits and a full kitchen.

highlights.text: Beach Village has the Oval Pool plus secluded plunge pools and jacuzzis throughout its grounds.
The Beachfront Fireside Cottage is a ground-floor cottage with a beachfront terrace with fire pit, full kitchen, living room with fireplace and a marble bathroom.
The Oceanfront Horizon Cottage is a top-floor cottage with an oceanfront balcony and day tub, two fireplaces and a private study.
Complimentary Del Beach sand chairs and umbrellas are included with a Beach Village stay.
Beach Village experiences include gathering around a private beach bonfire.

considerations.text: The cottages and villas are whole-ownership, limited-term occupancy resort residential condominiums.
Beach Village has mobility and hearing accessible rooms, including one with a roll-in shower.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and that advance booking is needed in peak seasons.
